prose: The Information reports that Huawei has told some clients a large share of its upcoming flagship AI chip, the Ascend 960DT, will run largely on high-bandwidth memory made by Samsung and SK Hynix - an illustration of how porous US restrictions on AI-chip shipments to China remain, since the memory inside China's flagship silicon still comes from allied-country suppliers.
highlights: The Information: Huawei's Ascend 960DT will largely run on Samsung/SK Hynix HBM, per client briefings
Export-control porosity: China's flagship AI chip depends on allied memory supply
